# CodeForces Round 1081 (Div 2)

## Solved Problems

### [A: String Rotation Game](https://codeforces.com/contest/2192/problem/A)

- check for number of blocks first
- if they are same letter start/end, already optimal
- else try to make a new block by splitting an existing one (unless only 1 block or all single length)

**[Sample code]()**

### [B: Flipping Binary String](https://codeforces.com/contest/2192/problem/B)

- parity logic (also order of operations does not matter)
- if odd 1's count, hold all 1's
- else, check if 0's count is odd, then hold all 0's if yes

**[Sample code]()**

### [C: All-in-one Gun](https://codeforces.com/contest/2192/problem/C)

- number of cycles through the magazine endurable?
- then optimize for fewest bullets from last magazine needed
- could use binary search here, not actually necessary with careful math implementation

**[Sample code]()**

### [D: Cost of Tree](https://codeforces.com/contest/2192/problem/D)

- track total (sum of subtree), score of subtree (without changes), best improvement, depth values, and depth of each node
- base case is single node at bottom of tree
- then try doing parents, 1 child just take best of child, else do some computation stuff to recompute best based on new depths (using md and md2)
- O(n) with multiple steps

**[Sample code]()**

## Unsolved Problems

### [E: Swap to Rearrange](https://codeforces.com/contest/2192/problem/E)

- For a while tried to setup some sort of greedy flipping pattern
- eventually thought this felt similar to 2-SAT -> use a graph?
- every node has even degree, can we just make a bunch of cycles to create the config? (turns out yes, even deg condition is enough)
- how to cycle decompose? turns out here greedy works
- very short on time to complete, and then this ends up exceeding memory limit
- really now. (replace here with the upsolve code with less of a memory mess)
